title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
在遥远的星球上，有一条龙。
他像小孩一样，爱玩爱笑，对世界上的一切都充满了好奇。
page_text_en:
On a distant planet, there was a dragon.
He was like a child, loving to play and laugh, and full of curiosity about everything in the world.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了一条绿色的龙在遥远星球上的场景，周围有其他恐龙和人类，龙显得活泼好奇，画面充满奇幻色彩。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
龙不停地玩，从不睡觉。
直到有一天，他玩累了，在大海的深处睡着了，一睡就是几百万年。
page_text_en:
The dragon kept playing, never sleeping.
Until one day, he got tired, fell asleep in the deep sea, and slept for millions of years.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了一条绿色的龙在色彩斑斓的海底世界中安睡的场景，周围有珊瑚、水母和各种海洋生物，文字说明它因玩累了而在大海深处睡了几百万年。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
当龙再醒来的时候，眼前的世界完全变了样！龙看到一条鱼骑着一只海鸟。
海鸟说：“自从我泡了这海水，就不会飞了！”
鱼说：“自从我泡了这海水，就不会游泳了！都怪这座城市里讨厌的科技！”
龙发现自己也不能飞了，他想：“科技是什么呢？真有那么坏吗？我要进城去看看！”
page_text_en:
When the dragon woke up again, the world before him had completely changed! He saw a fish riding on a seabird.

The seabird said, “Ever since I soaked in this seawater, I can’t fly anymore!”

The fish said, “Ever since I soaked in this seawater, I can’t swim anymore! It’s all because of the讨厌 technology in this city!”

The dragon realized he couldn’t fly either. He thought, “What is technology? Is it really that bad? I must go into the city to see for myself!”
summary_zh: 龙从海底醒来，发现世界已变，海水污染导致海鸟不会飞、鱼不会游，龙也失去了飞行能力，决定进城一探究竟。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
龙上了岸，"哇！到处是冒着浓烟的小火山啊！"
"喷喷喷！"没一会儿，龙的脸就被熏得黑黑的！
page_text_en:
The dragon came ashore. "Wow! Everywhere are little volcanoes spewing thick smoke!"
"Puff, puff, puff!" In no time, the dragon's face was smoked black!
summary_zh: 龙来到城市岸边，看到工厂烟囱冒出浓烟，惊讶地称其为小火山，不一会儿脸就被烟熏黑了。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: “唷！有一条铁龙！铁龙跑得真快！我们来赛跑呀！”
page_text_en: "Hey! There's an iron dragon! The iron dragon is running so fast! Let's race!"
summary_zh: 绿色的龙在城市中与一列高速行驶的火车并行，火车上的乘客们兴奋地看到龙，将其称为‘铁龙’并提议赛跑。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: “咦？现在人们都住在高高的房子里，出门坐在会跑的小房子里！”
page_text_en: “Huh? Now people all live in tall houses, and go out sitting in little houses that can run!”
summary_zh: 绿色的龙穿行在城市高架桥之间，观察着高楼林立和车水马龙的景象，感叹人们住在高房子、出门乘坐会跑的小房子（汽车）。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
龙看到玻璃大楼照出了自己，他从没见过镜子。
“呀！这是我吗？哇啦哇啦！哇唔哇唔！哇咧哇咧！”，
page_text_en:
The dragon saw his reflection in the glass skyscraper. He had never seen a mirror before.
"Wow! Is that me? Wah-la-wah-la! Wah-woo-wah-woo! Wah-lei-wah-lei!"
summary_zh: 龙在城市中看到玻璃大楼的倒影，第一次见到自己的样子，感到非常惊讶和好奇。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
龙在城里逛来逛去，到处都那么新鲜。
“这就是科技呀，真是又厉害、又便利、又好玩，科技带来的好处实在太多了！”
page_text_en:
The dragon wandered around the city, everything so fresh and new.
"This is technology! It's so powerful, convenient, and fun. The benefits technology brings are truly countless!"
summary_zh: 绿色的龙在城市中穿行，对高楼、车辆和直升机等现代科技景象感到新奇，感叹科技带来的便利与乐趣。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
突然，一架飞机向龙射去“催眠针”！
龙顿时全身无力，摔倒在地，很快被铁皮围挡包围起来。
page_text_en:
Suddenly, an airplane shot a 'sleeping needle' at the dragon!
The dragon instantly became weak, fell to the ground, and was quickly surrounded by metal barriers.
summary_zh: 龙在城市中穿行时，被一架飞机射出的‘催眠针’击中，瞬间失去力量倒地，并被铁皮围挡围住。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh: 大喇叭广播道：“这条龙是坏小丑公司抓住的！它是属于我们的！”，
page_text_en: The loudspeaker announced: "This dragon was caught by the Bad Clown Company! It belongs to us!"
summary_zh: 绿色的龙被铁皮围挡围住，躺在工地上，周围有工程车辆和持枪人员，大喇叭广播称龙是坏小丑公司抓住的，属于他们。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
坏小丑公司董事长说：“我从没见过龙呀！这么稀罕的东西，它将值很多钱！”
坏小丑公司研发主任说：“它将是最好的实验品！”
坏小丑公司抓捕队长说：“它将被改造成最强的怪兽武器！”
龙想：“唉，科技带来的坏处还是太多了。”
page_text_en:
The CEO of Bad Clown Company said: "I've never seen a dragon before! Such a rare thing will be worth a lot of money!"
The R&D Director of Bad Clown Company said: "It will be the best experiment!"
The Capture Team Leader of Bad Clown Company said: "It will be modified into the strongest monster weapon!"
The dragon thought: "Sigh, the bad side of technology is still too much."
summary_zh: 绿色的龙被坏小丑公司的人抓住并围困在工地，公司高层讨论如何利用它牟利或改造为武器，龙内心感叹科技带来的负面影响。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City
source_file: 城里来了一条龙（4-7 岁）.pptx
page_text_ocr_zh:
不一会儿，有三个孩子偷偷钻进铁皮围挡，他们是孩子王“喇叭队长”、聪明女孩“红博士”和小天才“发明家”。喇叭队长说：“多么可怜的龙啊，我们得救救他！
发明家说：“我负责发明设计，帮龙飞起来！可是我没有材料，并且还需要很多帮手！”
喇叭队长说：“我有办法，跟我来！”，
page_text_en:
In a moment, three children sneak into the iron fence: the child leader "Loudspeaker Captain," the clever girl "Red Doctor," and the young genius "Inventor." Loudspeaker Captain says, "What a pitiful dragon! We must save him!"
Inventor says, "I'll handle the invention and design to help the dragon fly! But I don't have materials, and I need many helpers!"
Loudspeaker Captain says, "I have a plan. Follow me!"
summary_zh: 三个孩子——喇叭队长、红博士和发明家——发现被围困的龙，决定救他。发明家提出要帮龙飞起来，但缺少材料和帮手，喇叭队长表示有办法并带领大家行动。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City

“嘟嘟嘟——”喇叭队长吹喇叭，全城的孩子从四面八方集合。
红博士让大家都化好妆，别被大人们认出来，就像去参加一场大型的化装舞会！

孩子们高喊：“我们的行动代号是什么？”
红博士说：“巨龙冲天计划！”“嘿，太酷啦！
page_text_en:
"Toot toot toot—" the Trumpet Captain blows his trumpet, and children from all over the city gather together.
Dr. Red tells everyone to put on their costumes, so they won't be recognized by adults, just like going to a big costume party!

The children shout, "What's our mission code?"
Dr. Red says, "Dragon Soars to the Sky Plan!" "Hey, that's so cool!"
summary_zh: 喇叭队长吹响号角，全城的孩子们穿着各式各样的服装从四面八方赶来集合，红博士宣布行动代号为“巨龙冲天计划”，孩子们兴奋地欢呼。

红博士让喇叭队长去找两个人，一个是住在垃圾场的“破烂儿大王”。
破烂儿大王爽快地说：“我支持这次行动！这里的宝贝随便拿！”
另一个是坏小丑公司董事长的儿子“大钢镚儿”，喇叭队长对他严厉地说：“如果你还想和全城的孩子玩，
就来帮我们完成计划！”大钢镚儿对龙的看守们喊：“我要参观龙！让我们进去！”
page_text_en:
Dr. Red asked Horn Leader to find two people: one was the 'Trash King' who lived in the junkyard.
The Trash King cheerfully said, "I support this mission! Take whatever treasures you want here!"
The other was the son of the chairman of Bad Clown Company, 'Big Steel Coin'. Horn Leader sternly told him, "If you still want to play with all the children in the city,
then help us complete the plan!" Big Steel Coin shouted to the guards watching the dragon, "I want to visit the dragon! Let us in!"
summary_zh: 红博士让喇叭队长寻找两位关键人物：住在垃圾场的“破烂儿大王”和坏小丑公司董事长的儿子“大钢镚儿”，两人分别表示支持救援行动并试图进入工地探望被围困的龙。

红博士说："男孩们按发明家的设计图纸，负责制造。女孩们还有秘密任务，跟我来！"

Dr. Hong said: "Boys, follow the inventor's blueprints and take charge of manufacturing. Girls, you have a secret mission—follow me!"
Children rushed into action. By evening, everything was ready.

坏小丑公司的坏蛋们追来了：“给我把龙抓回来！”
红博士和女孩子们早已准备好，放飞了发明家设计的“盾牌气球”和“钢铁风筝”！
它们挡住了坏小丑公司的坏蛋们。
page_text_en:
The bad guys from Bad Clown Company are chasing us: 'Bring that dragon back to me!'
Dr. Red and the girls were already ready, launching the 'Shield Balloons' and 'Steel Kites' designed by the inventor!
They blocked the bad guys from Bad Clown Company.
summary_zh: 坏小丑公司的坏蛋们追来要抓龙，红博士和女孩子们放飞了发明家设计的盾牌气球和钢铁风筝，成功挡住了追兵。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City

喇叭队长说：“龙，现在你能飞了，你想飞多远就飞多远吧！”
发明家说：“我还为你发明了特大号宇航头盔，你想飞多高就飞多高吧！”
红博士说：“未来我们长大了，科技会更发达，欢迎你再进城来玩！”
page_text_en:
Laba Team Leader said: "Dragon, now you can fly! You can fly as far as you want!"
Inventor said: "I've also invented a super-large space helmet for you. You can fly as high as you want!"
Red Doctor said: "In the future, when we grow up, technology will be even more advanced. Welcome back to the city to play!"
summary_zh: 龙在孩子们的帮助下成功飞起，喇叭队长、发明家和红博士分别鼓励它自由飞翔，并展望未来科技发展，欢迎它再次进城。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City

龙越飞越远，越飞越高，飞向了宇宙。
他说：‘看啊，我从没想过自己还能到宇宙来玩！这叫‘宇宙里来了一条龙’！
科技真是……既能做好事，也能做坏事，这取决于——我们的心。’
page_text_en:
The dragon flew farther and farther, higher and higher, into outer space.
He said: 'Look, I never thought I'd be able to come to space to play! This is called 'A Dragon Has Come to the Universe'!
Technology is truly... capable of doing good, but also of doing harm. It all depends on — our hearts.'
summary_zh: 绿色的龙在孩子们的帮助下飞向宇宙，它感叹自己能来到太空，并反思科技的双面性，认为其善恶取决于人心。

title_en: A Dragon Came to the City

景绍宗
北京人。中国工艺美术学会、北京民间文艺家协会、北京玩具协会会员。动画导演，绘本画家。
国家统编版义务教育教科书《语文》一至六年级封面画家，中国邮政特种邮票《儿童游戏》系列画家。
景绍宗生于典型的民俗世家，其曾祖父是老北京花会四大前引（花会也称香会，是中国民俗文化
的重要组成部分；前引即香会中的首要人物）。爷爷是京剧花脸，父亲擅长国画，这让景绍宗自小便
对老一辈人流传下来的民间艺术钟情有加。他凭借对传统文化的敬仰、童真的想象力和娴熟高超的绘
画技艺，让一个个温暖奇趣的东方故事落地生根，作品充满人文底蕴和民族自豪感。
景绍宗创作出了一系列优秀的原创绘本，如《梅里的雪山怪兽》《城里来了一条龙》《飞吧！爸
爸！》《景绍宗绘童谣》《布老虎》《父与子》和《母与子》等。这些作品不仅受到广大读者的热爱，更在
业内获得了高度认可。他的绘本多次斩获国内外奖项，成为畅销书榜上的常客，同时也屡获国家新
闻出版署的扶持。
与此同时，景绍宗还曾担任多部央视动画片导演，曾任北京电影学院动画学院、天津美院动画系、
中影集团华龙艺术学院等客座专家，受聘国内知名动漫大牌评委等。
“景绍宗可以说是一位动画、绘画双栖发展，艺术创作与传统齐头并进的创作人，实属难得。”
——摘自央视网书画频道 景绍宗专访

《城里来了一条龙》构建了一个想象的童话世界，一条好奇的龙，他比人类更早的生活在这星球上。有一天他
睡着了，睡了很久很久，当他醒来，发现四处高楼林立，现代科技已经改变了世界的样子。在这高科技的大都市里，
巨龙带来了城市的混乱和“人们的心灵风波”，有人利欲熏心，用“科技的狠活儿”抓捕了龙！而孩子们“小队队长”
和朋友们，也同样运用“科技”创造出奇思妙想的发明，开始了拯救巨龙的计划！
——摘自景绍宗《这一波创作经历》

page_text_en:
Jing Shaozong
Beijing native. Member of the China Arts and Crafts Society, Beijing Folk Literature and Art Association, and Beijing Toy Association. Animation director, picture book artist.
Cover artist for the national compulsory education textbook "Chinese Language" (Grades 1-6), and artist for China Post's special stamp series "Children's Games".
Jing Shaozong was born into a typical folk culture family. His great-grandfather was one of the four leading figures (also known as "Xianghui," an important part of Chinese folk culture) of the old Beijing flower parade. His grandfather was a Peking Opera face-changing actor, and his father was skilled in traditional Chinese painting. This background instilled in Jing Shaozong a deep affection for folk art passed down by the older generation. With reverence for traditional culture, childlike imagination, and masterful painting skills, he brings warm and whimsical Eastern stories to life, imbuing his works with cultural depth and national pride.
Jing Shaozong has created a series of outstanding original picture books, such as "The Monster in Meili's Snowy Mountains," "A Dragon Came to the City," "Fly, Dad!" "Jing Shaozong's Children's Rhymes," "The Cloth Tiger," "Father and Son," and "Mother and Son." These works have not only been loved by readers but have also received high recognition within the industry. His picture books have won numerous domestic and international awards, become bestsellers, and have repeatedly received support from the National News and Publishing Administration.
At the same time, Jing Shaozong has served as director for multiple CCTV animated series, and has held guest expert positions at the Beijing Film Academy Animation College, Tianjin Academy of Fine Arts Animation Department, and Hualong Art Academy of China Film Group. He has also been appointed as a judge for well-known domestic animation brands.
"Jing Shaozong can be described as a rare creator who excels in both animation and painting, advancing art creation alongside tradition."
— Excerpt from CCTV Art Channel's interview with Jing Shaozong

"A Dragon Came to the City" constructs an imaginative fairy tale world, featuring a curious dragon who lived on this planet before humans. One day, he fell asleep and slept for a very long time. When he awoke, he found skyscrapers everywhere and modern technology had changed the world. In this high-tech metropolis, the giant dragon brought chaos to the city and a "crisis of the heart" among people. Some, driven by greed, used "technological tricks" to capture the dragon! However, the children, led by "Team Leader," and their friends, also used "technology" to create ingenious inventions and began a plan to save the giant dragon!
— Excerpt from Jing Shaozong's "This Wave of Creative Experience"
